lines: Intense threefold from superior-middle descent: even the initiated gets no firm conviction in own-Śiva-ness — by ripening-order only, at body's-end, Śiva just.
From middle-intense, eager-for-Śiva becomes enjoyment-seeker; in initiation, knowledge-vessel — gained by yoga-practice, with this very body enjoying, at body's-end Śiva just.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi bhogaprepsuḥ bhavati iti tathaiva dīkṣāyāṃ jñānabhājanam sa ca yogābhyāsalabdham anenaiva dehena bhogaṃ bhuktvā dehānte śiva eva
